method: Locally opened 600x720 game photos; verified Commons file description, photographer, source, permission and work-credit where available.

eighteenPersonSummary.note: 12 earlier rejections from baseReview unchanged; six pending decisions replaced below.

decisions.name: 林采緹
decisions.identityEvidence: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%E6%9E%97%E9%87%87%E7%B7%B9_Sunny_Lin.jpg ; description names 林采緹 at 2017 板橋《美麗宣言》簽書會
decisions.reason: Face-centered, sharp; eyes/nose/mouth/chin visible; no mask or watermark. Must credit author and note crop.

decisions.name: 李妍瑾
decisions.identityEvidence: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2008TaipeiGameShow_Day4_CharityBid_YuniLi.jpg ; description names Yuni Li and depicts Lee Yen-chin
decisions.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (one of author's offered licenses)
decisions.reason: Clear frontal features, but a second person's face remains in lower left; Codex should recrop and submit new candidateId, gameSha256 and five-stage preview. Old photo cannot go live.

decisions.name: 林德信
decisions.reason: Local game image is heavily noisy/grainy and dim; face angle and low detail fail recognizability. Find a brighter, sharp, iconic frontal portrait.

decisions.name: 蔡黃汝
decisions.reason: 2011 era photo is grainy and does not represent widely recognized contemporary appearance. Replace with a clear single-person 2020s portrait, all features uncovered.

decisions.name: 鄭丹瑞
decisions.identityEvidence: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%E9%84%AD%E4%B8%B9%E7%91%9E.jpg ; image source is DBC video explicitly titled 始終小男人鄭丹瑞『越界傾情』 and Commons license was reviewed
decisions.reason: Near frontal; transparent glasses still show eyes, nose/mouth/chin unobscured. Some video grain but identity remains clear.

decisions.name: 葛民輝
decisions.reason: Cap shades eyes, beard and microphone obscure the chin-stage reveal; seek recognizable front-facing photo without microphone or lower-face obstruction.

additionalRejectedFalseMatch.name: 喜翔
additionalRejectedFalseMatch.reason: Caption identifies Jason King, Dean of USC Thornton School of Music, not Taiwanese actor 喜翔; English alias collision. Never publish.
additionalRejectedFalseMatch.fix: Require positive image-adjacent caption subject matching the specific Wikidata identity; filename or translated English alias alone must not be treated as proof.

pipelineFixes: Treat 403/proxy_access_denied as a blocked source, log host and retry-after; do not hammer the same endpoint or interpret it as no image.
Distinguish cirrussearch-too-busy-error from no results and back off with bounded retries.
Require subject-level visual/photo-adjacent caption evidence; reject ambiguous English names and article header-only matches.
Keep no-photo, image download failure, identity mismatch and license review concerns as separate statuses.
Generate per-candidate five-stage previews and contact sheets; do not auto-promote on face detection alone.
After acceptance, synchronize roster, eligibility-review, hint-candidates, hints, game bank, photo and attribution. Run prepare_hints and mobile QA before main.
